title: _apply_role_assignments no cooldown/dedup for role seat re-assignment

finding.claim: _apply_role_assignments no cooldown/dedup for role seat re-assignment
finding.recommendation: Add dedup/cooldown logic so re-assigning a role seat does not repeatedly rebuild and re-merge the same provider, which could flood logs or exhaust resources.

code_region.text:
role_models): lens pins for the two review lenses, the
    role -> seat-name map for the record, and the role ->
    {seat, provider, model, family} detail the record carries so
    anyone can see which model served which role. Raises
    ValueError/ProviderError on a bad assignment — callers turn
    that into exit 2, never a silent default."""
    assignments = registry.parse_role_assignments(role_values)
    lens_seats, seat_roles, role_models = {}, {}, {}
    for role, spec in assignments.items():
        desc = describe_spec(spec)
        built = build_providers([spec],
                                agent_timeout=agent_timeout)
        (seat_name, seat_fn), = built.items()
        if seat_name in providers:
            # Cross-kind collision (internal review, refutation-
            # weak finding on this seam): an agent role seat whose
            # name an API seat already owns (or the reverse) must
            # not silently record the role as served by the other
            # kind of seat. When the existing seat carries kind/
            # family tags that prove the mismatch, refuse loudly —
            # the same rule build_providers enforces inside one

refutation.reason: The code only builds and merges a role seat when its seat name is not already present in the providers map, so repeated assignment does not repeatedly re-merge the same seat. The claim as stated about missing dedup for seat re-assignment is not supported by this region.

probe.summary: Reachability probe (`probes/reachability_probe.py`, result `reachability-f56cd4a0b6c9.txt`): the same 3-role assignment set applied to one panel three times running (more than any CLI path does — each entry point applies once): 9 role-spec builds, 0 subprocess spawns, 0 provider calls, panel keys stable, the original seat object preserved in every round. The claimed re-merge does not occur (merges are name-guarded); the marginal cost of a repeat is one discarded callable construction per role. NO concrete harm sequence was found.
